segments.action: I walk along the ramp toward the entrance of the Cainiao XXX station.
segments.environment: Physical space: Outdoors on a paved walkway and access ramp in front of a storefront with signage for '菜鸟驿站' (Cainiao XXX) at 上海市浦东新区齐爱路510号 and an adjacent food stall '金陵小笼包'. Overhanging leafy trees, overcast daylight. A worker in a black t-shirt is moving parcels outside. Customers and a parked black car on the street nearby. Objects: Blue plastic crates on the right, large piles of cardboard boxes and delivery packages along the railing, multi-tier metal parcel racks on the left, blue flatbed trolley, transparent plastic strip curtain hanging across the entrance. segments.action: I say '要取快递。' to the worker handling packages outside.
segments.environment: The courier worker in black pulls a blue flatbed trolley stacked with brown cardboard parcel boxes near the doorway.
segments.details: I look toward the worker standing by the door and tell him I want to pick up a package.

segments.action: The worker says '哦，好。' as I look down at my phone displaying an SMS delivery message from PinXXX for package YT8803774708085 and lift the plastic curtain to enter the station.
